messages.text: Hi! Just wanted to check in on the website redesign project.
Hey Sarah! Everything is on track. We finished the homepage mockups yesterday.
That is amazing! Can you share them with me?
Of course! I just uploaded them to the shared drive. You should have access now.
Let me know if you have any feedback or changes you would like to see.
Sounds great! I will review the mockups tonight.
Quick question about the API rate limits we discussed.
Sure James, what do you need to know?
Can we increase the limit to 10,000 requests per minute for the Pro tier?
Absolutely. I will update the configuration and push the changes today.
Perfect, thanks!
Hi Emily, the analytics dashboard is looking great. Wanted to share a quick update.
I would love to see it! How is the real-time data feed working?
Latency is under 200ms. We are streaming via WebSockets with automatic reconnection.
That exceeds our requirements. Great work!
Hey! The brand identity package looks stunning.
Glad you love it! Lena really knocked it out of the park with the color palette.
Could we also get social media templates in the same style?
Definitely. I will add that to the project scope and send over a revised timeline.
You guys are the best. Talk soon!
Oh, one more thing - can we schedule a call for Thursday?
Rachel, the e-commerce storefront prototype is ready for review.
Awesome! I will check it out this afternoon.
Just reviewed it. The product pages look incredible. Love the AI recommendations widget.
Hi there! I saw your demo and I am very impressed.
Thanks Daniel! Happy to hear that. What features stood out to you?
The AI-powered analytics and the real-time collaboration tools. Can we schedule a deeper dive?
